response.sql: WITH phase_stats AS (SELECT o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS phase_avg, COUNT(DISTINCT o.observstation) AS station_count FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.lunarstage), overall AS (SELECT AVG(phase_avg) AS mean_phase_avg FROM phase_stats) SELECT AVG(p.phase_avg) AS avg_kept_bandwidth, SUM(p.station_count) AS total_station_counts, AVG(p.phase_avg - m.mean_phase_avg) AS avg_excess FROM phase_stats AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS m WHERE p.phase_avg > m.mean_phase_avg;
